name: Moonlight Ascension
source:
You're a runaway, shunned by the people in your town for your "witchy ways". You stumble into a werewolf den! What will you do to stay alive? And...maybe find love?

Choose from 3 dominating alphas, Ronin, Jun, and Aizen!

Who will you choose? Or maybe... you can have all of them.

[From [url=https://www.nutaku.net/games/alphas-bitch/]Nutuku[/url]]
translation:
你是一个逃亡者，因为你的“巫术”而被镇上的人们所回避。你不小心掉进了狼人巢穴！为了活下去，你会做什么？还有……也许能找到爱情？

从3位统治阿尔法中进行选择：Ronin、Jun和Aizen！

你会选择谁？或者也许……你可以拥有所有这些。

[来自[url=https://www.nutaku.net/games/alphas-bitch/]Nutuku[/url]]
